chapter_title: The Chapter on whether any [Lig]ht comes from the

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
When the inner faculty is lifted from lower states toward higher discernment, it comes into the inflowing wisdom that is received from the Divine. This wisdom enters by the established communications that stand open, and it proceeds in order through each successive degree of the mind, degree after degree.

In every distinct level of life there is a complete arrangement of ultimate forms for reception and transmission, set in a full compass of boundaries and turned toward uses below. Through these fixed openings the inflowing wisdom enters into prepared recipient states; it brings illumination to the region it touches, and it draws into operation the truths there together with the small measure of confirmed steadiness present—though the specific force intended by that steadiness is uncertain.

From that illuminated region the same inflow is then communicated onward into the succeeding degrees. In those degrees it is further made distinct and purified: one portion is cleansed of what is discordant and is taken up into conjunction with living affections and thoughts that receive it as life; but the remaining portion, which cannot be clarified because it does not agree with good and truth, is rejected and driven down into lower states.

paragraph_translations.translation: When a person wills to be raised, and the inner faculty is lifted toward higher things, it comes into the inflowing wisdom received from the Divine. This influx is welcomed, gives illumination, and passes inward through the great open communications of the higher degrees, proceeding in order from degree to degree.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the movement of ascent and the reception of higher influx into the mind’s ordered degrees.

paragraph_translations.translation: In each level of life there is a complete arrangement of ultimate receiving-forms set in a full compass of boundaries, all opening toward lower recipient states. Because of this ordering, the inflowing wisdom enters through these established openings, brings light to the region of reception, and draws forth into act the truths there and the small measure of confirmed stability present.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the mechanism of reception by describing the complete boundary-order that admits influx and activates what is within.
paragraph_translations.notes: The specific spiritual force meant by the “little pillar” is unclear; rendered as a small measure of confirmed stability.

paragraph_translations.translation: From that enlightened region the influx is communicated onward into the succeeding degrees. There it is made clearer and purified until it becomes distinct: one portion is cleansed and taken up into conjunction with living affections and thoughts, but the remainder, which cannot be made clear because it does not harmonize, is rejected and pressed down into lower states.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the outcome of influx by separating what can be purified and elevated from what must be rejected.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a single spiritual process: ascent of the inner faculty, ordered reception through degrees, illumination and activation of what is present, then purification and separation into what can be conjoined with living heaven and what is rejected downward. The only stumble is the “little pillar,” whose precise spiritual quality is not recoverable from context beyond a sense of minimal confirmed steadiness.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential substrate: ascent of mind is narrated as a functional process of reception and transmission through successive degrees (“firmament by firmament”), with no jurisdictional or named administrative overlay.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by function and process: “should the mind ascend upwards, it shall reach the light of the rays that comes from above… [they] go in through these great open gates… firmament by firmament.” The spiritual reading reports no narrative strain here and can map it coherently to ordered influx through degrees.

findings.diagnosis: Mostly clean correspondential teaching (ordered receptacles/openings at fourfold boundaries), but there is a likely small textual damage or mistransmission at the phrase “the little pillar that exists there.” This element does not participate in the described functional mechanism (rays enter → shine → pull light through openings) and creates the only interpretive stumble.
findings.evidence: The paragraph is otherwise purely functional/correspondential: “four gates open… distributed at the four points of the compass, opening downwards to the vessels… the light of the rays shall go in… and pulls through them the light…”. The insertion/problem is localized: “and the little pi[llar that ex]ists there.” The spiritual reading explicitly flags this as the only stumble: “The specific spiritual force meant by the ‘little pillar’ is unclear… not recoverable from context.” That is characteristic of a damaged lexeme/phrase (or a gloss) surviving in an otherwise coherent substrate, not of an administrative overlay (no ranks, powers, rulers, authorities, or named jurisdictions appear).

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential substrate: the teaching proceeds by states and outcomes (clarification/purification; separation of what can be taken up vs cast down). No seam, no systematizing addendum, no governance list.
findings.evidence: Functional sequence continues: “poured out to the firmaments… clarified… until it becomes distinct… a part… cleansed… taken up with the living ones… its other part… cast down.” The spiritual reading tracks this without forcing, as a single process of purification and separation, and removing anything would not improve coherence.

textual_criticism.summary: Issues found: 1 localized difficulty (¶3 “little pillar”) best explained as minor textual damage or an opaque term, not an administrative insertion. No administrative overlay blocks or seam-expansions detected. Recommendations: excise 0, annotate 0, none 3 (with one marked mixed due to localized corruption).

harmonized_paragraphs.text: [If one should wish to ascend,] b[u]t should the [mind] ascend [upwards, it shall reach the] light of the rays that [comes from above,] which are received, which shine and go in through these great open gates, through these doors, firmament by firmament.

For four [gates open]pen in each world, distributed at the four points of the compass, opening downwards to the vessels. So, due to this, the [light of the] rays shall go in through these openings and it shines on [that] place, and pulls through them the light and the little pi[llar that ex]ists there.

From that place [it] shall be poured [out to the] firmaments. It shall also be clarified in these firmaments [until it becomes distinct, and] a part there is cleansed and it is [all] taken up with the living ones. However, its other part [which is not able to be clarified,] shall all [be cast] down.

changes_summary: No changes made. All findings (¶2, ¶3, ¶4) carried a recommendation of none; ¶3’s localized difficulty (“little pillar”) was not recommended for excision or alteration.
